item.title: City of Magee Crews Prepare for Winter Weather
item.description: MAGEE, Miss. — The City of Magee Public Works Department remained on duty Sunday as winter weather moved through the area, taking proactive steps to ensure public safety. City crews were on hand throughout the day in anticipation of potential problems, sanding bridges Sunday afternoon as a precaution against icy conditions.
